acceptanceCriteria: Catalog becomes eligible only with at least five real culture cards and inserts one ad after card four; Trays becomes eligible only for explicitly selected History with at least six terminal records and inserts one ad after record five. No list-position inference and at most one request per eligible screen visit.

Before any SDK initialization/load, the first eligible interactive Android visit resolves canonical privacy. ConsentRequired navigates to the full SCREEN-015; Accept and Decline have equal clear actions, back implies no consent, and the configured HTTPS privacy action is safe-disabled when absent.

Settings exposes advertising privacy management only when fresh applicability makes it relevant. Accepted state offers withdrawal; decline/withdraw stop new requests and remove owned ad UI immediately without affecting product data.

Unknown/false eligibility, unresolved/declined consent, stale/malformed/offline/failed endpoint, short content, prohibited surfaces, previews/tests, missing ID, SDK/no-fill/load failure, or disposed host produce zero reserved space and never block core content.

Android uses the existing Yandex BannerAdView driver with host lifecycle disposal and shows a localized Advertising label only after the native ad reports loaded. There is no generic Compose placeholder and no duplicate banner per visit.
iOS stays unconditionally disabled with no banner view, placeholder, error, request, dependency or identifier; iOS/common compilation remains green.

All new user-visible copy and semantics exist in EN/RU production resources; deterministic component/Compose tests cover eligibility, exact insertion indices, privacy navigation/actions/withdrawal, collapsed states, lifecycle disposal, and conditional Settings reachability. Add deterministic preview states for the final ui-golden pass, but root records goldens later. Root owns Gradle.
goal: Implement production consent reachability and native ad rendering: resolve privacy only at the first sufficiently populated eligible Android Catalog or explicit Trays History visit; open the full Advertising Privacy screen before any request when required; support equal Accept/Decline, policy link, conditional Settings management and withdrawal; and render at most one lifecycle-owned Yandex inline banner at the exact approved insertion point only after successful load.
